perfEvidence.protocol: fresh JVM per measurement, rotated arm order, measuring runner pinned first, 10 warmup + 15 measured batches of 10000 permuted points per batch, p50 over all batches, FNV checksum over raw double bits
perfEvidence.reading: C (BEA0) reproduces B's values exactly and is materially faster; A differs because it carries the old geometry.
perfEvidence.caveat: single machine, fixed warmup, repeated point set: indicative, not a JVM-converged or in-game measurement
